label: Thin and act readings of perfection of being on one subsistent source: controls, checked
meaning: Two profiles of one subsistent source differing only in the reading of 'perfection of being' and what the source has: on the thin one whole-power possession holds and purity-as-perfection-of-being fails at the stand-in for life; on the act one both hold. The thin profile also satisfies R-act₁ with the reception and purity interfaces while R-act₂ fails. A structural surrogate.
